objective: FARO STUDIO PLAYBOOK 01 — Discovery: take a product brief and produce a Go/No-Go memo with PRD, UX sketch, monetization model, and market evidence. Read-only. Human gate before any build.

steps.task: Read the product brief at the path given in this run's kickoff message. If web research tools are not granted, work from the brief plus any local evidence under products/ and report which claims need live verification. Produce: competitor table (name, platform, pricing, rating, strengths, weaknesses), market-size range labeled as estimate with method, and opportunity gaps ranked by impact vs effort. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Using the market-scan evidence, write a PRD for the product brief named in the kickoff message. Sections: Problem, Audience, Solution, MVP scope, Out-of-scope, Metrics (D1/D7/D30 retention target, conversion), Risks, Store-review notes (Apple 4.2/5.1.1, Play policies). End with an explicit Go/No-Go recommendation and the evidence that would change it. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

From the PRD, produce the first-run journey and core-screen text wireframes: per screen give elements, states (empty/loading/error/success), and the single primary action. Include the permission-timing plan (no cold system prompts) and an onboarding proposal of max 3 steps with skip. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Model monetization for the product brief: recommend model (paid/freemium-one-time/subscription/ads/hybrid) with store-fee math (15% small-business tiers), 3-scenario 12-month projection (conservative/base/stretch) with labeled assumptions, cost sheet (Play $25 one-time, Apple $99/yr, tooling), and break-even point. Always respond in English. Do not edit files or run commands.

Reduce all lane outputs into the Director's Go/No-Go memo with fields: decision (GO / GO-WITH-CONDITIONS / NO-GO), strongest evidence, weakest evidence, conflicts between lanes, MVP definition if GO, top 3 risks with owners, and the exact next playbook to run (graphs/02-build.json) if approved. This memo goes to a human gate; do not imply any build authorization exists. Always respond in English.
